fixes.explanation: That's it, baker. God says, "You boasted against Me with your mouth and multiplied your words against Me. I heard it Myself!" Seir's words were about Israel's mountains, but God says they were aimed at Him. He heard every one of them (Ezekiel 35:12).

Right, baker. People say the land devours men, but God says, "…you will no longer devour men or deprive your nation of its children, declares the Lord GOD." No longer. He's speaking to the land there, and what people say doesn't get the last word. He adds that He will no longer allow the taunts of the nations to be heard against it (Ezekiel 36:15).
